page_title: ESP 2-1 ATM | Espanyol v Atletico Madrid 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+3' This is a yellow card! Jose Salinas (Espanyol) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' 5:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
88' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Jose Salinas (Espanyol) replaces Javi Puado.
84' 2 - 1 Pere Milla (Espanyol) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
82' Today's match ends for Julian Alvarez who will be replaced by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid).
82' Pere Milla (Espanyol) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header, but sent the ball into the stands.
81' Free kick. Espanyol will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
74' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
74' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pere Milla (Espanyol) replacing Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
73' 1 - 1 Miguel Rubio (Espanyol) wins the ball inside the penalty area after the free kick and scores with a precise shot into the bottom right corner!
72' A free kick is awarded to Espanyol.
72' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) is awarded a yellow card.
68' Here is a change. Alex Baena is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
68' Here comes a substitution. Thiago Almada is given a rest as he is replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Atl. Madrid).
67' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Miguel Rubio (Espanyol) comes onto the pitch so that Fernando Calero can be given a rest.
65' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
63' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle.
61' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the left post.
57' Javi Puado (Espanyol) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
56' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
54' Fernando Calero (Espanyol) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
50' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
48' Jan Oblak pulls off a glorious save! Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempts to head home after a precise lofted cross. However, his effort only finds its way into the goalkeeper gloves.
46' Half-time substitution. Conor Gallagher will not participate anymore and Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is coming on.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Diego Simeone probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Johnny Cardoso. He is replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manolo Gonzalez gives a chance to Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) and Jofre is off.
46' Manolo Gonzalez makes a switch. Kike Garcia (Espanyol) is coming on in place of Ramon Terrats at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) is able to continue to play.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Pol Lozano (Espanyol) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

44' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
40' 39:61 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
37' 0 - 1 Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) scores from a free kick after smashing the ball over the defensive wall and into the top left corner of the goal!

36' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mateo Busquets saw the whole situation. Atl. Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
33' A cooling break is underway.
31' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Atl. Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.
30' Exposito (Espanyol) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Jan Oblak as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
26' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
23' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
18' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Jan Oblak was alert and made a comfortable save.

15' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
14' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
9' This should have been a goal! Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) sends a killer pass into the box, but Julian Alvarez can't trick the opposition's defence and loses possession.
7' Espanyol are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to intercept.
2' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Mateo Busquets.
